_: Kill-check for asc-rzhr: recording what a gate run read, and comparing commits to it. The defects these mutants plant are the two directions a wrong answer gets worse in -- a commit reported covered that no run read, and the fields that make a run's verdict about content rather than about a checkout. Every killer below was found by planting the mutant and reading the failing test names off the runner's JSON, not by choosing the test that looked closest.

killers.test: moves the working-tree hash for an unstaged edit and leaves the index hash alone
records the two trees the run read, so a verdict can be matched to a commit
records the two trees the run read, so a verdict can be matched to a commit
does not ask a merge commit to be covered, and counts it rather than dropping it
does not cover a deletion with a tree that still holds the file

mutants.find: if (row['outcome'] !== 'ok') return { covered: false, why: 'the run did not pass' };
mutants.replace: if (row['outcome'] === 'ok') return { covered: false, why: 'the run did not pass' };

killers.test: does not cover from a run that did not pass

mutants.find: return { covered: false, why: 'the run recorded no tree (it predates the field)' };

killers.test: does not cover from a row that recorded no tree
reports two commits that change the same path, because the merged tree is neither of them

mutants.find: return { covered: false, why: `the working tree that run read differs at ${entry.path}` };
mutants.replace: return { covered: false, why: `the index that run read differs at ${entry.path}` };

killers.test: says which of the two trees disagreed, so a dirty checkout is not read as a stale index

mutants.find:
git(root, ['read-tree', 'HEAD'], env) === null &&
      git(root, ['read-tree', '--empty'], env) === null

killers.test: hashes an unborn HEAD, which is every fixture and every first commit

mutants.find: return { covered: false, why: 'the run judged nothing (the memo answered it)' };
mutants.replace: return { covered: false, why: 'the run recorded no tree (it predates the field)' };

killers.test: does not cover from a row that recorded no tree
